No default values. - params.sk (string) — The secret key - alg (SignatureAlgorithm) Returns - JWTBuildParts — jwt parts Creates a token from raw values Parameters - params (Object) - params.header (Object) — Any payload to add to the token header - params.payload (Object) — The payload for the token - sk (string) — The secret key to use for signature - alg (SignatureAlgorithm) — The signature algorithm to use Returns - string Signs a given payload (in string) using a given secret key and algorith Parameters - str (string) — The string payload - secret key (string) — The secret ey to use - alg (SignatureAlgorithm, default: "HS256") — The algorithm to use Returns - string Parses a jwt and returns the different pieces Parameters - token (string) — The JWT to parse Returns - JWTParts Verifies a jwt or throws. Checks for - invalid nbf (not before) - expired token (exp) (compared to Date.now() in seconds) - signature Parameters - jwt string (string) — The JWT in string format - sk (string) — The secret key to use Returns - Object — The body of the jwt Throws - TokenError Generates a JWT with default values. description: TokenGenerator Allows generating JWT tokens from pre-set defaults. Useful in smaller applications
content: TokenGenerator TokenGenerator Allows generating JWT tokens from pre-set defaults. Useful in smaller applications --- Constructor Parameters - init (Object) - init.secret key (string) — The secret key to use for this generator - init.iss (string) — The issuer, used as the iss claim in the JWT - init.max age (string) — The max age of the token, in seconds - init.alg (SignatureAlgorithm) — The algorithm to use --- Instance Methods Generates the payload to use in JWT. Adds { max age, iss, exp, jti } - exp is taken from the passed payload or forced to \null\\ - jti is a random UUID Parameters - payload (Object) — Extra payload. Overrides everythig else Returns - Object Generates a JWT, see Token generate Parameters - params (Object) - params.header (Object) — Extra header to pass to Token generate - params.payload (Object) — The payload for the token, uses generate payload Verifies a token against the secret key, alg and mabye allowed issuers Parameters - token (string) — The token to validate - params (Object) - params.allowed issuers (Array.\ ) — The list of allowed issuers to validate Returns - Object Throws - TokenError Proxy function to Token create passing this instance secret key and algorithm Proxy function to Token build` passing this instance secret key and algorithm
